title: Mark Package As Shipped
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-15
html:
Path: /fulfillment/202610/orders/{order_id}/packages

Method: [POST]

Function Description

This API is currently exclusive to the following markets: US, UK, ES, IE, IT, DE, FR, JP. This API is for sellers who fulfill orders through their own selected/preferred logistics carrier, and allows sellers to upload valid package information (items in packages, shipping provider information, and tracking number) orders/order line items to TikTok Shop. Use Get Shipping Providers API to retrieve the shipping_provider_id for shipping providers.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description

Get by API Get Authorization Shop
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Path Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
order_id string Y 576461413038785752 The unique identifier for a TikTok Shop order.

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

Request Body Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
order_line_list []object N This new parameter is completely backward compatible with the previous oder_line_items_ids field and in addition this supports bundle order splitting, use the sub items accordingly
^order_line_id string N 5767675021119438849 The corresponding order line ID.
^sub_item_id string N 5767675021119438849 The sub-order-line ID inside a bundle product.
  • Required for bundle products.
  • Not required for non-bundle products. | shipping_info_list |[]object |N | |"Only supports uploading multiple tracking numbers for split-shipment in 3PL single item scenarios (non-virtual bundle) (This function is only support for whitelist sellers； If you are not on the allowlist, it is recommended to contact AM to apply) For other scenarios, only one tracking number can be uploaded at a time." | ^tracking_number |string |N |6617675021119438849 |Tracking number. | ^shipping_provider_id |string |N |12312312321323432 |Use Get Shipping Provider API to retrieve the shipping_provider_id for shipping providers. | ^note |string |N |this is a table |"Only available for a part of white list merchants.This applies to scenarios where a large single item needs to be shipped in multiple packages.Merchants not on the whitelist who upload this field will have it automatically ignored by the platform. For example, where Package 1 is marked with ""headboard"" and Package 2 is marked with ""bed frame"". This field will be displayed to buyers, so please fill it in carefully." |

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/fulfillment/202610/orders/576461413038785752/packages?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY

Body

{"order_line_list":[{"order_line_id":"5767675021119438849","sub_item_id":"5767675021119438849"}],"shipping_info_list":[{"tracking_number":"6617675021119438849","shipping_provider_id":"12312312321323432","note":"this is a table"}]}

message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^order_id string 32131324123321 TikTok Shop order ID.
^order_line_item_ids []string ["31322412312312"] List of order line item IDs.
^package_id string 32141235124234 Package ID.
^warning object Warning message.
^^message string match more than one provider Specific warning information.

Response Sample

{"code":0,"data":{"order_id":"32131324123321","order_line_item_ids":["31322412312312"],"package_id":"32141235124234","warning":{"message":"match more than one provider"}},"message":"Success","request_id":"202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7"}
